newsitem.title: MEXICO: S&P rates Sanborn commercial paper mxA-1.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Sanborn commercial paper mxA-1.

text.p: Rating agency Standard & Poor's Corp said on Thursday it has given a rating of mxA-1 to Sanborn Hermanos SA de CV's 150 million peso commercial paper program.
The issue will be renewed next week.
S&P also said it also reaffirmed the mxA-plus rating assigned to Sanborn's two medium-term pagares worth 600 million pesos each.
The outlook is stable, it added.
S&P said the ratings were due to the steady cash flow that Sanborn generates and its financial flexibility as part of Grupo Carso.
The negative effect of the economic crisis on Sanborn's sales and margins was also taken into account, it added.
A rating of mxA-1 is the highest rating in S&P's CaVal scale for short-term paper and represents "a strong grade of security with respect to the timely payment of interest and principle."
